title: Welcome, Referee
body:
This short tutorial will take you on a journey through the Hex Realm Generator.
- Learn what the core tools are.
- Learn where you can find them.
 :info: **Note:** You can use the **arrow keys** to navigate through the steps. 
 This tutorial does not cover all settings

title: Command Toolbar
body: This toolbar allows you to change the configuration of your realm. In the next steps, we'll break down each section.

title: Generate & Configure
body:
## :sparkles: Generate 
 Build a fresh realm using your current settings.
## :settings: Settings 
 Open granular generation options to tune grid size, grid type, how the terrain is generated, and how new myths are placed.
## :grid: Grid 
 Adjust grid color, spacing, and visibility on the fly. 
 
 :info: **Note:** I went quite far with the terrain generator settings, looking forward to what you can do with it!

title: View Modes & Settings
body:
## :eye: Referee vs. Knight View 
 Toggle visibility layers for referee or knight.
## :settings: View settings 
 Open detailed visibility controls allowing you to customize what elements are shown in what mode.

title: Realm Presets
body: Open curated generation themes and color palettes. Jump into settings when you need deeper tweaks.

title: Import & Export Realm Data
body:
## :upload: Import Realm Data 
 Load saved realms including generator settings, color schemes and myths.
## :download: Export Realm Data 
 Export the current realms including generator settings, color schemes and myths into a json file.

title: Export Realm PNG
body: Open the PNG export modal to frame your map, tweak overlays, and download your realm as an image.

title: Export Preview
body:
- Toggle overlays like grid, icons, and spray.
- Switch referee/knight visibility.
- Download the exact preview shown.

title: Realm Canvas
body: Your realm is visible here. Pan, zoom, and click to inspect or paint hexes.

title: Tools Palette
body:
- Shortcuts 1–5 jump directly to each tool.
- Active tool will show additional details on the sidebar docked on the right.

title: Select Tool
body:
- Inspect hex details, change holdings, and attach myths.
- Great for editing and managing individual hexes.

title: Select Tool Sidebar
body:
Edit the state of the selected hex.
- Update terrain type. 
- Update terrain character (from spark table in the book). 
- Update holding type or landmark 
- Add/Remove myths 
 :info: **Note:** When no hex is selected, you can enable or disable tooltips on hover.

title: Terrain Painter
body:
- Paint terrain types hex by hex.
- Sample existing colors with the pipette and adjust clusters quickly.

title: Terrain Painter Sidebar
body:
- Brush character applies the selected character to painted hexes. 
- Change colors by clicking on the swatch 
 - Upload custom icons by clicking on the icon. 
 - Click/Hover on the :info: icon to learn more about the terrain type. 
 :info: **Note:** For the brush character, preserve existing means that the brush will not overwrite the existing terrain character.

title: Barrier Painter
body:
- Draw boundaries into your realm. 
 - Set your own custom barrier color. 
 - Erase or remove all existing barriers.

title: Point of Interest Painter
body: - Place holdings, landmarks, and travel icons

title: Point of Interest Painter Sidebar
body:
- Configure icon styles, backdrops.
- Add myths and change the seat of power. 
- Upload your own custom icons and backplates for holdings and landmarks.

title: Myth Tool
body:
- Add, configure and name your myths.
- Relocate myths with drag-and-drop to adjust pacing.

title: Myth Tool Sidebar
body:
- Track myth details and location.
- Add your own myth names. 
 - Update myth marker styling

title: Quick Save Slots
body:
- Snapshot your entire realm state into quick slots.
- Enable local storage to persist saves between sessions.
- Rename slots to track your own custom realms.

title: Undo & Redo
body:
- Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y or these buttons step through edits.
- Undo painting, myth placement, or imports safely.

title: Tour Complete!
body: You now know the lay of the land. Happy realm building, Referee!
